raw_text: ALERT: Sophisticated cyber attack detected targeting ISRO telemetry data centre in Bengaluru. Spear-phishing emails impersonating senior ISRO officials sent to multiple employees. Attack appears timed to coincide with Chandrayaan-3 post-landing operations. Lateral movement attempts toward mission control systems detected and blocked.
clean_text: Cyber attack targeting ISRO telemetry data centre in Bengaluru detected. Spear-phishing emails impersonating ISRO officials with lateral movement attempts toward mission control.
